evaluation_philosophy.reason: Models were evaluated on the same leakage-safe development data, temporal folds, target definitions and task-specific metrics.
evaluation_philosophy.selection_strategy: Temporal stability was prioritized over a single high validation score.

late_payment.business_question: Is this invoice likely to miss its due date?
late_payment.why_selected: LightGBM improved both median temporal AUC and worst-period AUC over Gradient Boosting.

calibration.reason: Sequential Platt calibration reduced ROC-AUC and PR-AUC, so the raw model score was retained.

delay_over_7d.business_question: What is the probability that the invoice becomes more than 7 days late?
delay_over_7d.why_selected: Random Forest retained stronger overall temporal discrimination and its Platt calibration passed the honest temporal audit.

delay_over_15d.business_question: Will the invoice become more than 15 days late?
delay_over_15d.why_experimental: The target has insufficient positive support in later temporal periods and could not be honestly sequentially calibrated.

expected_days_late.business_question: If the invoice becomes late, roughly how many days late will it be?
expected_days_late.why_selected: XGBoost achieved lower temporal MAE than the LightGBM challenger.

p80_lateness.why_selected: It outperformed the LightGBM quantile challenger and achieved substantially better P80 coverage.

important_explanations.why_not_one_model_everywhere: Different prediction tasks have different target distributions and loss functions. RecoverIQ therefore selects the strongest temporally stable model separately for each task.
important_explanations.why_not_lightgbm_everywhere: LightGBM improved late-payment risk but did not outperform the existing champions for lateness regression or quantile prediction, and its >7-day calibration was inferior to the Random Forest pipeline.
important_explanations.why_not_xgboost_everywhere: XGBoost was strongest for conditional lateness regression but was not the most temporally stable classifier for all binary targets.
important_explanations.why_temporal_validation: Invoices occur through time and payment behaviour changes. Random train/test splitting could leak future regimes into training and produce unrealistic performance estimates.
important_explanations.why_test_is_locked: The reserved test set is intentionally untouched while model architecture, calibration and champion selection are being finalized.

business_value.interpretation: Exposure-aware prioritization captures substantially more risky cash than ranking invoices only by late risk.
